course.name: Events
course.description: Expose a flow through a button or form and verify the invocation.
course.longDescription: 30 minutes required. Start after Thinking in Flows. Build a Quick Action, choose an entry contract and open a routed form. Optional classes add 7 minutes for schedules and 8 minutes for messaging and device Events. Release and Rollback owns production version changes; API Integrations owns HTTP reliability.

modules.title: Build and check
modules.description: Complete the practical steps and inspect the result.

lessons.title: Run a flow from a Quick Action

challenges.prompt: You delete Practice action from Events. What should still exist?
challenges.explanation: The flow and its nodes; only this invocation configuration is removed.

options.label: The flow and its nodes; only this invocation configuration is removed.
Neither the flow nor its nodes.
A frozen copy of the flow owned by the deleted Event.

lessons.title: Choose the entry contract and runtime

challenges.prompt: A hub enables hosted Telegram delivery while another hub does not. Which source decides the available remote option?
challenges.explanation: The selected hub capabilities and the Event configuration, checked together.

options.label: A universal rule that Telegram is always local.
The number of nodes in the flow.
The selected hub capabilities and the Event configuration, checked together.

lessons.title: Open a form through a route

challenges.prompt: A Page renders in the builder but has no address in the app. What is missing?
challenges.explanation: A UI Event targeting the Page with an active, unique route.

options.label: A Cron expression on the Page.
A UI Event targeting the Page with an active, unique route.
A duplicate copy of the Page in app storage.

modules.title: Optional classes
modules.description: Choose the classes that match your work.

challenges.prompt: Your local test schedule has no run while Desktop was stopped. What should you check before scheduling unattended work?
challenges.explanation: A supported continuously available trigger/runtime and its missed-run behavior.

options.label: A supported continuously available trigger/runtime and its missed-run behavior.
Whether a UI route can wake the laptop.
Whether renaming the flow creates the missed run.

challenges.prompt: A generated inbound email address is required around the clock. Which setup should you investigate?
challenges.explanation: Inbound Email with server support, rather than assuming the local IMAP Mail Event provides that address.

options.label: A Page route named after the email address.
A desktop-only Cron Event with no mail connection.
Inbound Email with server support, rather than assuming the local IMAP Mail Event provides that address.

modules.title: Apply it
modules.description: Use the result to solve a new case.

challenges.prompt: A form needs named request fields, but its flow has only a Simple Event. What should change?
challenges.explanation: Add a Generic Event with the required typed fields and target it from the form Event.

options.label: Add a UI route and expect it to create payload pins.
Add a Generic Event with the required typed fields and target it from the form Event.
Rename the Simple Event to Generic Form.

challenges.prompt: A valid flow works in Studio but the configured Event produces no run. What should you inspect next?
challenges.explanation: The Event active state, target node/version, trigger configuration and available runtime.

options.label: The Event active state, target node/version, trigger configuration and available runtime.
The wording of every log message.
The color of the flow comments.

challenges.prompt: A schedule ran successfully but its output file is absent. What can you conclude?
challenges.explanation: Invocation succeeded, but the intended outcome still needs investigation.

options.label: The file must exist because the run is green.
The schedule needs a UI route.
Invocation succeeded, but the intended outcome still needs investigation.
